title: Apollo Go: Pioneering Inclusive Mobility for the Visually Impaired
summary: Baidu reports a limited rollout of audible arrival alerts, automatic unlocking, and voice controls for visually impaired passengers. Long-term mobility effects are unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Baidu reports a limited rollout of audible arrival alerts, automatic unlocking, and voice controls for visually impaired passengers. Long-term mobility effects are unmeasured. Limited public robotaxi rollout. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Make robotaxi journeys easier to use for visually impaired passengers.

ratings.reason: The limited public rollout provides audible arrival, automatic unlocking, and voice-first controls for visually impaired passengers. This supports an accessibility capability gain, without proving durable independent mobility.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: Apollo Go: Pioneering Inclusive Mobility for the Visually Impaired

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Compatible Apollo Go vehicles and voice/Bluetooth interfaces
Co-design and feedback from visually impaired users

headline: Apollo Go adds accessible robotaxi controls

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
